## Checklist

**Note:** All substantive amendments will be reviewed by the HumanAIOS governance process (Z1 proposer, Z2 ratifier) and considered for inclusion in the next version. Community signal, evidence quality, and alignment with HumanAIOS practices influence prioritization.
